title: Give the desk a surface model of its own instead of QLC+'s virtual console document
notes: On 2026-10-28 the console moved behind `struct desk_console` with desk commands and events, and QLC+ became the first adapter (`core/qlc_console.c`). The model is still built from `struct vc_doc` (`showmap_build`, `desk_rebuild_model`, `desk_speed_validate`), so a second adapter (Onyx, MagicQ, OSC, MIDI) would have to fake QLC+'s widget tree. Next: list what the model actually reads from the snapshot (widget ids, types, function ids, speed dials, StopAll) and define the smallest desk-side surface description that covers it; then make QLC+'s adapter translate `/vc.json` into it.
result: struct desk_surface (core/desk_surface.h) replaces QLC+'s vc_doc in validation, speed dials and the model; the QLC+ adapter translates /vc.json with qlc_surface_of
evidence: 151112a. Host suite 54/54 (91 PASS), qlc_surface_test with a negative control, Qt ctest 7/7, ARM -Werror build clean, e2e --qt-pipe frames/states/logs identical to bdd589d in stall-free runs
